label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 25
title: MVP: live 360-degree multi-agent discovery meeting in the project ideation/discovery round
body: Owner requirement: the live 360-degree multi-agent/role discovery (every major agent asks its own LLM-generated clarifying questions + a recommended answer, one at a time, role-attributed, with accept/override) must be a first-class DASHBOARD experience during the project creation / ideation + discovery round - not only in the CLI. The dashboard renders the panel as proper dialogs (grouped by agent, recommendation shown, Accept / Override), writes answers to discovery-panel.json via the pipeline, then shows the synthesized refined brief. Pairs with BI-0038 (discovery panel dialogs), BI-0015 (surface all modules) and BI-0033 (HIL dialogs). Release blocker.
